scripts.migrate: uv run --project apps/backend python apps/migrate/migrate.py upgrade
scripts.migrate:check: uv run --project apps/backend python apps/migrate/migrate.py check
scripts.check:backend: cd apps/backend && uv run ruff check src tests ../migrate && uv run ruff format --check src tests ../migrate && uv run mypy src tests && uv run pytest -q
scripts.check:frontend: cd apps/frontend && npm run typecheck && npm run lint && npm test
scripts.check: npm run check:backend && npm run check:frontend && npm run migrate:check
